item.title: CFTC rules split prediction markets from sportsbooks with event contracts as swaps and comments due November 18, CasinoJournal reports — Oct 28, 2026 · 5:30 AM ET
item.description: - **CFTC rules split prediction markets from sportsbooks with event contracts as swaps and comments due November 18, CasinoJournal reports** — CasinoJournal reports two CFTC documents published in the Federal Register on Oct. 19 set out the split: sportsbook wagers and casino games are not swaps and belong to state and tribal regulators, while event contracts on sports, politics, culture and weather traded on federally registered exchanges are swaps under the CFTC. The interim exclusion took effect Oct. 19 and the proposed inclusion for 17 CFR 1.3 is not yet in force, with comments on both due Nov. 18. ([CasinoJournal](https://www.casinojournal.com/news/cftc-swap-rules-prediction-markets-sportsbooks))
